groupings.title: Writing
groupings.description: Prose aimed at a person — drafting outbound email under policy, and rewriting a message that carries more frustration than its author wants to send.

groupings.title: Docs
groupings.description: Prose aimed at whoever opens the repository next, written from what the repository's own files say rather than from its name.

groupings.title: Dev
groupings.description: The loop around a change — pull the base branch level, land the change as a merged pull request, then remove what shipping left behind.

groupings.title: Astrology
groupings.description: Positional astrology from birth data — charts, aspects, and house overlays computed with the Swiss Ephemeris and reported as data, with the reading left to the reader.
